name: PowOS play tools
purpose: The gaming pack's command-line tools in the PowOS image: powos-play (runs a Windows .exe through Proton without Steam's container), powos-pack (adds the packs the base image leaves out), powos-progress (one Android progress notification per long job: pack download/unpack, Steam bootstrap and self-update), powos-steam (Steam launcher). Command-line tools, nothing runs on its own.
installedBy: targets/android/rooted/powos-deploy.sh (targets/android/play/*), and install-powos-android.sh at image build
